scope: One actual application-owned GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo CLI boundary, fifteen retained provider/account/repository controls and captured worktree execution/filesystem guards. No CLI installation, native OAuth flow or new events.
implemented: The actual protected-profile ProductionOwner creates and retains one GitProviderProcessOwner and the existing three managers. AgentManager, WorktreeManager, SyncManager, task-source plugins, mobile API and provider backends borrow those exact objects. The process owner drains before database/key/profile-lock release.

Captured execution permits only finite trusted programs, environment keys and physical home/cwd/worktree roots. Provider auth environment remains opaque inside actual trusted CLI children; model, broker/task tokens, arbitrary shell/askpass programs and inherited environment are refused. PATH removes empty, relative and duplicate lookup components without changing the parent.

Raw execFile callback and actual child/stdout/stderr close receipts all remain owned. Deadline, error, cancellation and TERM/KILL alone never acknowledge completion. Scoped guards join accepted parallel siblings, recheck owner/current grants before every nested command and after raw completion, and refuse late fallbacks/mutations without replay.

Actual GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo managers preserve CLI-based discovery, pagination and authenticated accounts, using bounded explicit pages, rows and JSON/output capacity. Legacy constructors retain existing Electron behavior. Portable public errors contain fixed codes/messages and omit raw diagnostics and credentials.

Fifteen retained commands preserve exact existing DTO/argument/undefined contracts and current trusted-main read/write grants. Forgejo login selection validates the actual configured login list before the existing database write; provider mapping uses the existing SQLite writer, bounded exact map and current configuration snapshot.

Production worktrees use the same captured CLI owner. Trusted roots, task/repository/ref inputs and Forgejo clone addresses are checked before effects. Awaited cleanup rechecks captured directory device/inode identity and refuses replacement directories/links, preserving unrelated user files. Forgejo clones retain the fixed tea credential-helper and existing Git refspec setup.

The production native policy and desktop facade mirror all fifteen exact codecs. Reads may run during recovery; login/map writes wait for hydration and do not replay after disconnect. Useful unavailable capability states remain explicit. Actual TypeScript golden payloads are exported and checked against Rust policy.
